summary: No stack satisfies all hard constraints at once; the critical warnings name what blocks it and what to relax.

warnings.message: The load estimate (peak about 1500 requests/s, 400,000 users in 12 months) usually needs at least $260 per month of infrastructure; the budget is $40.
Use a hosted checkout from a PCI DSS certified provider so card data never reaches your servers.

Every compatible stack costs more than the hard budget of $40 per month. The cheapest option is React Native (Expo) with Firebase (BaaS) and Cloud Firestore on None (provided by the backend platform), about $250-$600 per month.

If you treat the budget as firm rather than hard, a stack becomes possible: React Native (Expo) with Supabase (BaaS) and Supabase Postgres on None (core layers plus required supporting services about $560-$1,200 per month).
